question: List the first 5 artist names.
sql: SELECT Name FROM Artist ORDER BY Name ASC LIMIT 5;

question: Show each album with its artist name (first 5).
sql: SELECT Album.Title AS AlbumTitle, Artist.Name AS ArtistName FROM Album JOIN Artist ON Album.ArtistId = Artist.ArtistId ORDER BY Album.Title ASC LIMIT 5;

question: How many albums does each artist have? Return top 10 by album count.
sql: SELECT Artist.Name AS Artist, COUNT(Album.AlbumId) AS AlbumCount FROM Artist JOIN Album ON Artist.ArtistId = Album.ArtistId GROUP BY Artist.Name ORDER BY AlbumCount DESC, Artist ASC LIMIT 10;

question: Top 5 genres by number of tracks.
sql: SELECT Genre.Name AS Genre, COUNT(Track.TrackId) AS TrackCount FROM Genre JOIN Track ON Genre.GenreId = Track.GenreId GROUP BY Genre.Name ORDER BY TrackCount DESC, Genre ASC LIMIT 5;

question: Total sales amount in 2010.
sql: SELECT SUM(Invoice.Total) AS TotalSales FROM Invoice WHERE strftime('%Y', Invoice.InvoiceDate) = '2010';

question: Top 10 customers by lifetime spend.
sql: SELECT Customer.CustomerId, Customer.FirstName || ' ' || Customer.LastName AS Customer, SUM(InvoiceLine.Quantity * InvoiceLine.UnitPrice) AS TotalSpent FROM Customer JOIN Invoice ON Customer.CustomerId = Invoice.CustomerId JOIN InvoiceLine ON Invoice.InvoiceId = InvoiceLine.InvoiceId GROUP BY Customer.CustomerId ORDER BY TotalSpent DESC, Customer ASC LIMIT 10;

question: Number of customers per country (top 10).
sql: SELECT Customer.Country, COUNT(*) AS CustomerCount FROM Customer GROUP BY Customer.Country ORDER BY CustomerCount DESC, Customer.Country ASC LIMIT 10;

question: List the 5 most expensive tracks (by UnitPrice).
sql: SELECT Name AS Track, UnitPrice FROM Track ORDER BY UnitPrice DESC, Name ASC LIMIT 5;

question: How many invoices are there in total?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS InvoiceCount FROM Invoice;

question: How many media types exist?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS MediaTypeCount FROM MediaType;
